body.name: Assignment-only primitive and policy bands
body.construction: For a sampled design \(S\neq\varnothing\) with \(n_c\in\mathbb N_{>0}\) for every \(c\in S\) and \(\sum_{c\in S}n_c=N\), let \(J=|S||\mathcal X|\). Define \(\widehat y_{cx}^{\mathrm{HT}}=N_x^{-1}(N/n_c)\sum_{i\in\mathcal I}\mathbf1\{Z_i=c,x_i=x\}Y_i^{\mathrm{obs}}\), \(\varepsilon_{cx}=q_x^{-1}\sqrt{\log(2J/\alpha)/(2n_c)}\), \(l_{cx}=\max\{0,\widehat y_{cx}^{\mathrm{HT}}-\varepsilon_{cx}\}\), \(h_{cx}=\min\{1,\widehat y_{cx}^{\mathrm{HT}}+\varepsilon_{cx}\}\), and \(\mathcal O_S(\pi)=[L_S(\pi;l),U_S(\pi;h)]\). This randomization-band construction has domain \(S\neq\varnothing\); the empty panel has a separate deterministic population-width statement.
